Within-cluster / cluster-level assignment probability

Source: R/weights.R
dot-calc_treatment_probability.Rd

Probability of treated_neighbors treated out of total_neighbors_in_cluster draws, under the within-cluster (or cluster-level) assignment law dist with parameters params.

Usage

.calc_treatment_probability(
  dist,
  params,
  treated_neighbors,
  total_neighbors_in_cluster,
  total_size,
  cluster_id = NULL
)

Arguments

dist

"binom" or "hypergeom".

params

for "binom", list(prob = p); for "hypergeom", list(m = m) where m may be a scalar or a per-cluster vector.

treated_neighbors

number of treated draws (vectorised).

total_neighbors_in_cluster

number of draws.

total_size

population size of the cluster (or the number of clusters for a cluster-level law).

cluster_id

optional cluster id used to pick the entry of a per-cluster params$m.

Value

A numeric vector of probabilities.

Examples

## Binomial law: P(2 of 3 neighbours treated) with p = 0.5
generalClusterExp:::.calc_treatment_probability(
  "binom", list(prob = 0.5), 2, 3, total_size = 10)
#> [1] 0.375

## Hypergeometric law: 2 treated among 3 draws from a cluster of
## size 10 containing m = 5 treated units
generalClusterExp:::.calc_treatment_probability(
  "hypergeom", list(m = 5), 2, 3, total_size = 10)
#> [1] 0.4166667
